genuine_vs_learned_discriminator.split_unit: source clip; paired genuine/generated rows never split

genuine_vs_linear_discriminator.split_unit: source clip; paired genuine/generated rows never split

interpretation: Lower learned discriminator performance than linear is evidence of a closer held-out feature distribution; chance performance still does not prove rendered-video or human-perceptual naturalness.
descriptor: masked interval plus two genuine boundary frames; 24-frame resampling; frame-vector position, velocity, acceleration, endpoint statistics; fixed label-independent 128D projection; source-clip-grouped CV
limitations: This evaluates v17 landmark trajectories, not rendered RGB video.
The held-out data contains one signer and 48 source clips.
Reconstruction of a hidden observed interval is easier than unconstrained text-to-sign generation.
A human Deaf-signer perceptual study is required for a genuine naturalness claim.
